meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 为已有的谈话、采访或播客视频,叠加与说话内容同步的图文卡片(标题、下三分之一字幕条、数据标注、引语、侧面板、画中画),再渲染成带这些图形的 MP4 视频,原片画面保持不动。
howto.when: 当你要求给现成视频加“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”,或说“包装/装扮”一下视频时触发;纯字幕需求不会触发,会转交其他技能。

say.text: 给这个访谈视频加上和说话同步的标题和数字卡片。
say.note: 会生成渲染好的带图文卡片的视频。

say.text: 把这段播客视频包装一下,重点加引语条和侧栏信息。
say.note: 会按内容设计卡片并添加到原片上。

say.text: 给这个演讲叠加大标题、数字图表与下三分之一字幕条。
say.note: 时长太长的视频会拆成多个子合成。

howto.what_en: Packages an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video with timed, designed graphics — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, then renders the result as MP4. The source clip is not modified.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for graphic overlays, on-screen graphics, or packaging/dressing up an existing video; plain subtitles are not handled.

say_en.text: Add titles and number cards synced to this interview.
say_en.note: Designs cards and outputs a rendered MP4.

say_en.text: Dress up this podcast clip with quote bars and side panels.
say_en.note: Overlays are composed over the original video.

say_en.text: Add kinetic titles, a chart, and a lower-third to this talk.
say_en.note: Long videos are split into sub-compositions.
